problem_statement:
Parser.named_fields returns incomplete list when field names contain hyphens

#### Description

When using field names with hyphens in parse templates, the `named_fields` property returns an incomplete list that's missing the last field name.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import parse

template = '/local/sub/{user-id}/duration'
parser = parse.Parser(template)
print("Named fields:", parser.named_fields)
print("Expected:", ['user_id'])

# Also affects templates with multiple hyphenated fields
template2 = '/foo/{user-id}/{user_id}/{user.id}/bar/'
parser2 = parse.Parser(template2)
print("Named fields:", parser2.named_fields)
print("Expected:", ['user_id', 'user__id', 'user___id'])
```

The `named_fields` property should return all field names but currently returns an incomplete list when hyphens are present in field names.
